worker: Entropy; original v0.13 640x480 Wine/Xvfb, one 1.15 vCPU-cap graphics lane; CPU PPO image inference/collector colocated in its own 0.75 vCPU-cap container.
physical_transport: All high-volume RGB observations and keys are passed through local FIFOs. Only finished compressed packets are copied to the learner. A deliberate minimum 50 ms key hold applies before the next image; original game native RNG and software-rendering wall rate are uncontrolled.
interpretation: Observation-to-echo includes X framebuffer handling, transfer across local FIFOs, sampling, inference and X application. This is not a GPU-only kernel time. Original-frame tick frequency is not directly measured by these wall timestamps.
